besluite.fout: Two coordinate adjectives ('dik' and 'vlesige', both describing the stems and leaves) stand without the separating comma.
besluite.rede: The AWS comma between coordinate adjectives is a plain punctuation fix and leaves the meaning exactly as it was.

besluite.fout: The glossary definition has the same missing comma between coordinate adjectives, and once change 1 is applied it will differ in punctuation from the study text.

besluite.fout: 'loop wyd en vlak uit' is a loose verb for roots; 'uitloop' leans towards sprouting or running out.
besluite.rede: 'versprei wyd en vlak' is the exact, natural verb for roots spreading, keeps the same meaning, and leaves the rest of the sentence (including 'om vinnig reën op te vang', a wording dropped from change in an earlier round) untouched.
The first 'dus' carries the inference from the previous sentence (the lightest shades, like the poles) and is contrasted by 'egter' in the next, so dropping it loses a logical link for little gain.
